body: I think we should not reuse `HTMLCollection` algorithms like this. The "act like" does not define what data that method then operates on, doesn't really deal with the issue of it being overwritten by JavaScript, etc. It seems cleaner to either have an algorithm that both can use (and is passed the collection the object holds) or just duplicate the algorithm. This also seems to apply to `length`.
